stock.description: Q P Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily involved in the production and distribution of paper-based goods. The company's operations span diverse international markets, including the People's Republic of China, the United States, and Europe. It manages its business through two main channels: Web Sales, catering to individual and corporate clients via online platforms, and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Sales, serving other businesses. Their extensive product range features tabletop games, playing cards, puzzles, greeting cards, and educational items, in addition to providing packaging services. Beyond its core product offerings, Q P Group delivers various ancillary services such as printing, laboratory testing, dedicated customer support, and IT infrastructure management tailored for its online sales operations. The company also holds property assets and participates in the general trading and retail of merchandise. Founded in 1985 and based in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, Q P Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Good Elite Holdings Limited.
